snippet.title: BFDI: Branches Demo - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
BFDI: Branches is an all-new platformer game with Firey, Leafy, Coiny, and Pin! Featuring multiple characters with varied gameplay, a story mode with branching paths, a complete level editor, and an online level browser!

it’s out, it’s FINALLY out, after 9 months of development.. it’s done.
thank you so much for you guys support for the game, and especially team branches.

Download and Play the Game here: https://teambranches.itch.io/bfdi-branches

Enjoy! And expect more videos about the game,
Thank you.
